title: 目標達成の後に・あの回のように

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Trainer recognizes my effort and gives me the OK to enter the Japanese Oaks! I'm doing the Tiara tour for real!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'm late to the press conference and get scolded for not giving serious responses. Oh… This is such a disaster…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I need to mentally mature and learn to properly respond to my fans' expectations! I'll stake everything on this Princess☆Right Hook!
